correctness.rationale: The three starting formulas are the classical Pluecker values for a general smooth degree-d plane curve. After removing the factor d, every gcd calculation is reduced exactly to consecutive-integer coprimality, one mod-3 check, and one mod-4 dyadic check. The triple gcd follows because the only possible extra factor from the dual-degree/flex pair is 3, and the normalized bitangent count is nonzero mod 3 when d is 1 mod 3. The embedded checker independently verifies the complete formulas through degree ten thousand.

value.rationale: Dual degree, inflection tangents, and bitangents are the three basic enumerative outputs of classical Pluecker theory for a general smooth plane curve. The theorem determines their entire common-factor lattice uniformly in the curve degree: it isolates the unavoidable geometric factor d, proves the normalized triple is always primitive, and identifies every additional pairwise overlap by exact congruence conditions. This gives a compact arithmetic structure theorem for a canonical classical enumerative package rather than an arbitrary numerical slice.
